templates.pattern: A [M] kg object is heated using a [P] W heater for [T] seconds. Its temperature rises by [DT]°C. What is the specific heat capacity of the material?
templates.explanation: Energy supplied = P×t = [P]×[T] = [P*T] J. c = E ÷ mΔT = [P*T] ÷ ([M]×[DT]) = [P*T] ÷ [M*DT] = [RESULT] J/kg°C

templates.pattern: A fuel has an energy density of [ED] MJ/kg. A [M] kg sample is completely burned with [EFF]% efficiency. How much useful energy is released in MJ?
templates.explanation: Useful energy = energy density × mass × efficiency = [ED] × [M] × [EFF]/100 = [RESULT] MJ

templates.pattern: A [V] V supply is connected across a [R] Ω resistor. What is the power dissipated?
A Carnot engine operates between a hot reservoir at [TH] K and a cold reservoir at [TC] K. What is its maximum theoretical efficiency as a percentage?
An efficiency chain has three stages with efficiencies of [E1]%, [E2]% and [E3]%. What is the overall efficiency of the system as a percentage?
A transformer has [N1] turns on the primary coil and [N2] turns on the secondary coil. If the primary voltage is [V1] V, what is the secondary voltage?
templates.explanation: Transformer equation: V2/V1 = N2/N1 → V2 = V1 × N2 ÷ N1 = [V1] × [N2] ÷ [N1] = [RESULT] V

templates.pattern: A power line transmits [P] kW of power at [V] kV. What is the current flowing through the line?
A power line has resistance [R] Ω and carries a current of [I] A. How much power is wasted as heat in the line?
templates.explanation: Power lost = I²R = [I]² × [R] = [I*I] × [R] = [RESULT] W. This is why high voltage transmission reduces energy losses.

templates.pattern: A photovoltaic solar panel of area [A] m² receives solar irradiance of [G] W/m² and has an efficiency of [EFF]%. What is its electrical power output?
A [M] kg object is launched vertically upward at [V] m/s. What maximum height does it reach? (g = 10 m/s², assume no air resistance)
templates.explanation: Using energy conservation: KE = GPE → ½mv² = mgh → h = v² ÷ 2g = [V]² ÷ 20 = [V*V] ÷ 20 = [RESULT] m
